unit.unitinstructions:
Using AI while still learning

You will explore how AI can help with schoolwork while affecting what you learn. Read each question and answer by typing or selecting an option, as directed. For written answers, explain your thinking when the question asks you to.

The system will check your responses and choose what comes next. It may provide feedback, explanations, or examples as you work through six ideas. You will also learn about a study that compared AI-assisted math practice with later work done without help.
